QuestInfo.name: Checking on the Temple of Time
QuestInfo.0: It's time to check on the Temple of Time. Talk to Corba at Leafre Station to gain access to the temple.
QuestInfo.1: It's time to check on the Temple of Time. Talk to #bCorba#k at #bLeafre Town Station#k to learn how you can transform into a dragon to access the temple.
QuestInfo.2: When you get to the temple, you discover the Gate of the Present is open when it shouldn't be...
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Investigate the #bThee Doors#k of the Temple of Time
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 100,000
Can proceed to The Gate of the Present Opens

0.0: The final place we must check is the Temple of Time. That's the spot the Black Mage and the Heroes battled ages ago. It's where the Black Mage is sealed.
0.1: The Maple Alliance frequently sends people to the Temple of Time to scope it out. So far, the reports have come back with nothing alarming, but I have a bad feeling this time...
0.2: Are you brave enough to handle whatever you might find at the #bTemple of Time#k?

yes.0: The entryway to the Temple of Time has been hidden. \r\nTo access it, find #bCorba#k at the highest point of Leafre #bStation#k. He'll give you powers to enter the temple.
yes.1: You will find three doors when you arrive. Currently, only the Gate to the Future works. The Gate of the Past was destroyed by someone and no one has ever yet entered the Gate of the Present.
yes.2: Please, investigate all Three Doors in the Temple of Time.

no.0: I have a really bad feeling about the Temple of Time. Are you sure you won't go?
